interface.title: CRNS Data Hub (Streamlit)
interface.field: Hydrology / cosmic-ray neutron sensing (CRNS) of soil moisture
interface.stage_of_work: Data harmonisation, processing-pipeline control, monitoring and exploratory analysis of field-sensor time series
interface.what_it_is_for: A control and viewing hub for a network of cosmic-ray neutron soil-moisture sensors: check each sensor's status and location, run the sync/merge/neptoon/calibration/report steps with live logs, and plot, filter, correlate and export the merged time series.

data.note: One bundled sensor ('01', site MQ1 near 52.466 N, 12.958 E) with data/.merged/merged_01.csv: 108 rows × 13 columns at 20-minute steps, 2025-11-11 to 2025-11-12. Columns: Internal_press, N1_cph, N2_cph, Internal_t, Internal_rh, N1, N1ET, N2, N2ET, SMT1_vwc and SMT2_vwc. The sensor location comes from the bundled location_metadata.xlsx. There is no processed data (data/.processed is empty), and the neptoon run could not create any because it needs NMDB data from the internet.
